nom: Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Recovery Moisturizer SPF 50

avis.titre: I have been buying this for years!
avis.texte: I have probably been using Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Recovery Moisturizer for 20 years or so. I love the feel of it…light as can be but powerfully protecting my skin with a 50 SPF. I'm frequently complimented on how unlined my face is. I attribute that to good genes (thank you mom!) and this moisturizer.

avis.titre: Changed my sensitive and redness prone skin
avis.texte: I got this as a sample for my birthday gift. My skin has changed after having persistent acne and redness since the 7th grade (I am 25 now)! Just after three weeks. I have bought all of the minis from this brand and im obsessed. I experience no redness when i apply it and i have had 0 breakouts. Great for sensitive skin!!
This is my first trying Dermatologica products and so far I love this light weight moisturizer with SPF 50. Skin feels so smooth and hydrated throughout the day. It smells so good

avis.titre: Not worth eyes burning for this price, but fine otherwise
avis.texte: Ultimately I wrote this review because of how disappointed I was that no matter how I applied this sunscreen, it always burns my eyes, and I don't want to spend this much money for that to happen this often. I still gave 3 stars because this sunscreen is great otherwise (love how moisturizing it feels, I like the scent, works effectively, texture is not too creamy or liquidy). Maybe it's just something about my eyes, but I don't have this issue with other sunscreens.

I received this product as a birthday gift and in a little sample pack and I loved it so I went out and bought it and it wasn't the same. The birthday sample was much thicker and it was much smoother. The one I bought off the shelf made my face bump up and I didn't like that. It was a different product to me I have sat on the shelf too long, but I love the sample

I stumbled on this product during my facial. It's a great SPF, non greasy and does not white-up. (Haven't tried in water). Extremely pricey! But if you want a glow and results with aging in perfection, wala!

avis.titre: I am buying this product again
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer so much, it's the only one I ever found that makes my dry skin feel so soft! Will buy over and over again!
Found this a few years ago and it's perfect. I have combination skin and it feels wonderful. Never greasy or dry. Love that I don't have to layer sunscreen with it.

When I started using this product my skin had hyperpigmentation areas that were so embarrassing. My stepdad even asked me one day what happened to my face after he hadn't seen me in a while without makeup :/ I wasn't treating it, just covering it up with makeup. After using this product a while one day I realized my dark areas (most of my forehead and above my lips) were fading. I hadn't changed anything else. Today I no longer have any hyperpigmentation on my face. I have to credit that to this product because again, it was the only thing I had changed in my routine. I use this daily and I highly recommend it.
It feels nice but the floral scent is too much, had to return.
The product felt good on my skin but irritated my eyes probably due to SPF.

avis.titre: I have brought this product over and over again
avis.texte: Absolutely love this product I use it everyday. I have recommended to friends and family.
I've been using it for years. Its berry moisturizing. I love how it's not matte when it goes on, and it does absorb and leaves your skin soft and not greasy.
I've been using this product for around 10 years now. Obviously, it gets no complaints from me.
I love Dermalogica moisturizers. I got this initially as a sample. I was happy with how smoothly it went on and didn't leave an SPF scent. Purchased a couple on sale so I could have in my stash!

avis.titre: Yes I would purchase this Dynamic skin recovery spf 50 I Lov
avis.texte: Yes I would purchase this spf over and over it does what it says !
This product line is always so consistent and keeps my skin looking younger

Unfortunately this is least favorite product ive ever tried! The smell is very strong (old granny perfume), burned and irritated my eyes even though i was careful around that area, broke me out so bad it took months to recover and has a slight whitecast. The upside is that its a high spf and is really convenient to have a 2 in 1 product. Unfortunately I will never repurchase again unless its completely and totally reformulated

I tried the sample size and loved it. When I saw the minis were BOGO, I purchased it because I loved having a smaller size to carry with me in my purse and work bag. I'd definitely repurchase this SPF again. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate it or have a weird scent.

This Moisturizer was perfect for me in the weather ( Purchased in March 2025). This summer, every time I used it, within 1-2 hours eyes are burning me ( I work in a room with no sound light). I will be going back to trader joe daily sunscreen.

I used to have patches of dark skin on my forehead and upper lip. I realized after a couple months of using this that my patches were fading. I've used this product for several years now and no longer have the dark patches. I will not go without this product. It provides fantastic sun protection as well. I spend a lot if time by the pool and rely on this for my face spf. It has worked wonderfully.

This cream is not like my favorite— Lancôme Renergie HPN 300, but ok. I tried it because the Lancôme is getting very pricey. It's a bit thicker and has hardly any scent but doesn't have all the great ingredients like the Lancôme.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again and again there's n
avis.texte: I do recommend this product to my friends and families and anyone that I can
I have tried so many products for my dry skin from inexpensive to expensive. There's something my skin loves about Dermalogica products, this one included!
Love this product. Been using for years. Plays well with skin care and make up!

avis.titre: So pleasantly surprised by this product!
avis.texte: I was just looking for a sunscreen when I came upon this, but the moisturizer aspect is incredible and makes my skin feel so noticeably soft and I had an almost glow even hours after I've put it on. I wish I'd known about this product years ago. I hope they don't change it!

On my quest to find a good sunscreen after 30 years of not being diligent about using it, (i know shame on me), this Dermalogica Skin Recovery was unfortunately a miss. The smell is extrnely strong and herbal. Not horrible on its own, but add that it burned my face and left it greasy and red for awhile, i cant be continuing to use it. Like the high spf, but i think the lesson for me, personally, is that mineral sunscreen is the way to go since rhe chemical sunscreens seem to make my seemingly mild rosacea that i had under control, just completly inflamed again.
Excellent! I have a hard time finding SPF coverage for my face. This product is perfect for moisture and sunscreen coverage.
I use it on my arms and neck. This gets in my eyes and is irritating.
A bit thick. Can't workout in it because it breaks my face out.
This is the. Amazing SPF I have ever used. It goes on smooth and doesn't leave a white film. The bottle lasts forever too!
One of my favorite Dermalogica products, as it not only hydrates my dry skin, but also has spf 50, which is great sun protection.
I love this face moisturizer! My skin looks and feels amazing. It's so hydrated and bright!

This is a repurchase as I love how my skin looks and feels. I live in a desert climate and this hydrates my skin without making it feeling oily or overly dewy. It's the perfect primer for my makeup as it blurs my pores and gives my tinted moisturizer a nice base, Honestly, I think my skin looks better than it has in years!

I have used this product for about three years and seen a huge reduction in my dark pigmentation. It totally protects my skin from sun damage. At moisturizes beautifully, my skin looks young and healthy.

The smell and texture was nice and moisturizing, I loved it upon application. However 3 hours later under the sun, the sunscreen start stinging my eyes, my friend who also applied it also got the burning sensation in his eyes. It did not go away until I putting settling powder around mine and his eyes. So use with caution, I barely get eye irritation from sunscreen and this one gave me a headache.
I hoped for better results but I am willing to try it for another month
I don't go outside without out it. Rain or shine, summer or fall. It's an absolute must.
I just began using this product. It is too early for tell anti-aging results but I like the feel of the product and the fact that is has SPF 50, so I am pleased with my purchase.
Love the feel of this skin recovery with sunscreen. Light and doesn't cause breakouts.

avis.titre: Love the product not the price
avis.texte: I love everything about this moisturizer except for how expensive it is! I will say its worth it.🤷🏻‍♀️
I've used dermalogica products for over 20 years and I look 10 years younger! The new dynamic skin recovery with SPF50 is my new go to!

Great hydration and love that it has SPF. It's really important for me to have SPF for my skin since I have spots and live that it moisturizes and protects at the same time. I just wish it didn't smell so strong. A kid said I smelled like Christmas because of its strong scent. Other than that, it's a good product.
absolutely love. this product. It protects but also makes my skin look healthy, smooth! I get complements every time I wear it.
This is a must during the spring and summer! I am losing moisture in my mid 40s, so this moisturizer helps my skin feel healthy, moisturized, and protected!
Nice glow. Good moisturizer. Do not get anywhere near your eyes.
I love this product. I never get a sunburn. . I wear it every day. My only complaint is is the cost. .
This is one of my favorite products. I always get compliments on my skin when using this to duct. Skin is glowing.

This sunscreen is great! Does not make my skin feel oily and makes my skin feel hydrated all day. Shared some with my mom and loves it. Bought a larger bottle for her since she loved it so much, but it's expensive!!!
The best, but I think I might give biolumin-c heat aging protector spf50 a go. .
Absolutely love this product! Very smooth, not greasy and fabulous sun protection!
Love this moisturizer with SPF50. Put on in the morning . . don't need to worry about sunscreen!
I keep buying this. It absorbs great and causes no irritation. Just a nice daytime moisturizer.
I have used this product for years and find it to be the BEST moisturizer with spf50 that keeps my skin glowing, moisturized and no side effects.

Love this face cream. I had gotten away from it for a few years but I'm back to it. Ri GB g now it's still affordable for me which is important. But also important is how it leaves my skin smooth and hydrated. Plus it has sunscreen! Love it!

avis.titre: Best SPF Moisturizer I've ever used!
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for over 15 years! It's actually my very first introduction to the Dermalogica line. I loved the creaminess, non greasy after-feel and how it is quickly it was absorbed. It was a bit pricey, I thought, but after that first bottle and seeing the results, it's my only spf moisturizer since. I look forward to trying the upgrade - the biolumin-c heat aging protector spf50. I'll definitely leave a review.
I am satisfied with the product. I have recommended to friends and family.
It's ok I guess, don't make me break out, but the skin is a bit whitish and too shiny
I love the full coverage without feeling as if I've clogged my pores. Additionally, it provides great hydration, leaving my skin feeling moisturized and protected.

Oh helloooo velvet custard in a bottle. To say I'm obsessed with this texture is an understatement. Texture to me is everything. I just LOVE how this glides on and makes my skin look super healthyâ€¦ bouncy and glowing! It's so hard to find a moisturizer, even one with a sunscreen, that doesn't have a scent in that chest feels good. This feels so good, I need this formula for everything. I would absolutely love. Just love to have this formula also without the SPF, because this is something I would drench my skin in when going to sleep. That's how much I believe in this moisturizer and how much it has changed my skin.
I like the combination of a hydrating moisturizer that also is a sunscreen. It does not have a heavy feeling like some with sunscreen have
Very light feel, amazing under makeup. No build up. Hydrates my face for the entire day, creating clear bright skin. I definitely recommend this product
Excellent moisturizer with SPF protection. Absorbs completely into skin without leaving any residue, greasiness or stickiness.
Love this product. I use it almost everyday now that it's spring and I'm in the yard planting flowers. My skin feels so moist.
I struggled to find an SPF that didn't leave that white look and that didn't peal off. This one checks those boxes. I love it!! Smells very good too.

Have used this over the last few years and I actually really like it. Like to have the added SPF to my aging skin ( along with the SPF of my foundation but much lower) if I'm out I actually always have a hat on. I'm always working with my skin care line to minimize or get rid of sunspots/ age spots. The cream is that, a creamâ€¦ it's alittle heavy. But it absorbs quickly leaving no white on your face and no residue. Alittle goes a long way too. Don't over pump!!! I will definitely continue to use.
This is my go-to daily moisturizer for several years now. Makes my skin look and feel great.

First time I have ever been able to wear spf on my face. I love it. Matter of fact I love all the products I have tried. I couldn't put anything on my face before. I have reactions to chemicals. But your products do not bother me. I am so happy with everything I bought.
Always my favorite. Have used this for years. Great sun protection and moisturizing all in one!
This moisturizer is perfect for my combination skin. It's not too oily and hydrates well.

This moisturizer is the absolute best I have used in years. Even with the SPF, which is a bonus, I would wear this around the clock. It feels like velvet going on your skin, and feels so divine. Very moisturizing without leaving behind any feeling.Absolutely so comfortable to wear.
Feels really good on my skin. Easy to re-apply. I really like the light scent
This is the best moisturizer with sunscreen. It protects and feels great on your skin
This moisturizer is definitely a win for your face! I love the pump bottle making application easy. The blend provide rich moisture and protection throughout the entire day.

avis.titre: Keep coming back to this product
avis.texte: This is my all time favorite. My oily forehead doesn't breakout with this. It does a great job moisturizing the rest of my drier spots. Have tried other products, as it is pricey, but keep coming back to this one. Nothing beats it. The SPF is great too. If I am out during the day, I can tell on my other skin that my face and neck were protected.

avis.titre: Hands down the best sunscreen moisturizer made
avis.texte: I have been using this for 8 years i love that is a moisturizer with sunscreen and believe i apply once and never get burned. It gives your skin a health glow without looking sticky, shiny. I hope they never discontinue making. Try it you love it. My daughter also uses and she has acne prone skin and she also loves it

I am a redhead so lord knows I need sunscreen every day but I sweat more than anyone I know. If its remotely humid and I put sunscreen on, it acts like a greenhouse effect for my face. I also HATE the smell of sunscreen. I have been trying to track down a sunscreen that doesn't smell gross and also doesn't make me sweat for 6 years and I finally found it. I never review products but this has blown me away I had to review. It's a hefty pricetag, but for someone who needs sunscreen and who sweats like I do this was an absolute game changer.
Does what it says, non-irritating, genuinely moisturizing, but far too expensive for the amount of product.
A smooth and hydrating sunscreen that does not burn my eyes! My absolute favorite!

This moisturizer is unmatched. I love that it comes in a travel size because I can't live without it. My skin feels so smooth and hydrated I love the creamy consistency. The ingredients leave my skin healthy and it creates the perfect foundation for makeup. gifted by dermalogica

This has great benefits, I love that it has SPF50 and it gives me a wonderful glow after. However, this breaks me out every time I use it. I've had this product for months and I didn't know for sure if it was from this product since I noticed I didn't have any the beginning of me using it. I decided to stop using it and my face was getting better. I'm so sad because this is not a cheap brand and this was definitely on the pricer side. I love their stabilizing repair cream super great. But I'll have to give this to a family member to see if it works better for them.
this is by far the best spf cream I've found. im 39 and i have dry skin. this product helps me get nice smooth skin. I've gotten rid of so many wrinkles in my face by using this product religiously.

avis.titre: Love it. So lightweight. No whitecast
avis.texte: My new bff. Gifted by dermalogica. so I've been using this moisturizer for a while now, and I'm hooked. It's like the perfect blend of hydration and sun protection. It's super lightweight, so it doesn't feel greasy or heavy, and it does a great job at smoothing out my skin. I know it's a bit pricier than some other options, but it's totally worth it. Basically, if you're looking for a good moisturizer that'll keep your skin happy and healthy, this is it.

avis.titre: The SPF could be lower but…
avis.texte: I love my travel sized moisturizer because I've been noticing some slight changes to the complexion of my skin. I have been targeting some fine lines I've been getting around my mouth area and neck because I'm a year away from 30. I wish the SPF was a tad lower but I like that there's SPF in it. It's a good product to have and I'm glad I was gifted by dermalogica.

Gifted by Estée Lauder , Loved the product, it was lightweight and perfect for my night time routine. It worked perfect on my sensitive skin, I will continue to incorporate it into my everyday routine. It was not overly fragranced and blended nicely.

I try to find products that already have SPF included so having this available in travel size is not just convenient, but also a great product. It's moisturizing without being heavy so it's great for daytime wear. Its great as a base before applying foundation. Gifted by dermoligica.

Dermalogica's Dynamic Skin Recovery SPF 50 has become my go-to daily moisturizer. From the first application, I loved how it felt on my skin—lightweight yet deeply hydrating. It blends seamlessly and leaves my skin feeling firm and smooth, making it a perfect base for makeup. I've also noticed a brighter complexion and improved elasticity over time. Plus, the broad-spectrum SPF 50 gives me peace of mind knowing my skin is well-protected.

avis.titre: Love that doesn't leave a white cast!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is very hydrating and perfect for someone like me who often forgets to apply sunscreen before leaving home. Its milky, lightweight texture absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn't leave any white cast. It's perfect for layering under makeup without feeling greasy or heavy. The dual-action formula hydrates the skin while providing sun protection from uv rays. Gifted by Dermalogica!

Very hydrating with not a strong scent. The travel size is perfect for tossing in a daily bag, and reapplying when the spf has worn off or washed off. My skin didn't get burned in the sun, so the spf50 seems to work well! Something I will definitely repurchase. Gifted by detmalogica

I think this has become my new favorite moisturizer. I always like to have spf in a moisturizer and I love that this one is 50 spf. It's creamy and very hydrating and wow the glow that you get after applying it is beautiful! Gifted by dermalogica

I felt the difference in a few days w my skin. I do notice a bit on the greasy side but its still worth the results on your skin. I have used a non oily primer like the MILK product primer and it helps

I lived this dynamic skin recovery SPF 50! After going on a vacation to Hawaii where the sun was brutal this product has become a must have in my everyday life and wear!! I absolutely loved this product and will be purchasing! Gifted by Dermalogica

i like this product! you can definitely tell that if has spf in it. but somehow it also seems like it's very light weight. does not leave you feeling very greasy either which i like as well. overall a nice sunscreen!! offered by dermalogica

This is my favorite SPF! The only thing I can complain about is that it doesn't sit well with my makeup but it is the absolute best for no makeup days. It has great coverage and makes my skin look smooth hydrated and glowy. gifted by dermalogica

I'm really impressed with gifted by Dermalogica's Skin Recovery. It's incredibly hydrating and leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. After using it for a few weeks, my skin looks more radiant and feels noticeably softer. Perfect for sensitive skin—definitely a game-changer in my routine!

avis.titre: Love a two in one product
avis.texte: I love that this moisterizer has sps in it! It's a very thick formula but doesn't leave a white cast on my skin and my makeup applies nicely overtop. This kept my skin hydrated without making it oily. Gifted by demalogica

I was gifted by Dermalogica. This is a great hydrating spf 50. It blends into my skin so nice and effortlessly. I have dry skin and this is a wonderful addition to my morning skincare routine. I especially love that it has peptides and sqalene too.

Been enjoying this Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Recovery SPF 50 Moisturizer. I have a sensitive dry skin and this moisturizer been so good to my skin. It gets absorbed fast into the skin and love that it is SPF 50. I use spf all year round and this one is becoming my fave. Love that it doesn't make my skin greasy or leave a white cast like other SPF. I used it under my makeup and it is so good. Also love the travel size perfect to take with you anywhere. Gifted by Dermalogica

This product was offered by dermalogica. This is perfect for on the go travel, in the car, or to have in your purse. The spf is great for everyday use. Great product to have in your carry on during holiday. I will be keeping this moisturizer on hand for sure.
